name: blue-satin-girl-butterfly-encounter
image_purpose: Lifestyle portrait and nature-encounter social content

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic portrait in an indoor butterfly garden with natural wonder and rich blue satin styling.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman with long dark brown hair, natural glam makeup, a soft smile, and an elegant blue satin dress with secure coverage and subtle drape. Her right hand is raised near her face.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 3:4 medium close-up in a lush greenhouse cafe. A black-and-cream butterfly rests near her nose and a vivid blue morpho butterfly perches on her raised hand. Hanging vines and blurred visitors fill the background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft daylight through greenhouse glass with gentle greenery bounce, clean satin highlights, natural warm-neutral skin, shallow background bokeh, and subtle analog grain.
prompt.technical_specs: 85mm lens, f/1.8, eyes and butterflies sharp, realistic skin and hair texture, cinematic but natural color, vertical 3:4.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A photorealistic vertical 3:4 greenhouse portrait of one approved adult woman with long dark brown hair, natural glam makeup, a soft smile, and an elegant securely covered blue satin dress. Her right hand is raised near her face; a black-and-cream butterfly rests near her nose and a vivid blue morpho butterfly perches on her hand. Lush hanging vines, glass ceiling, softly blurred visitors, soft natural daylight, gentle greenery bounce, realistic skin and satin texture, 85mm, f/1.8, dreamy intimate natural mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, distressed insects, malformed hands, extra fingers, distorted butterfly wings, plastic skin, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, random text, watermark, random logos, celebrity likeness, low resolution, blur

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve the approved adult subject, safe blue satin styling, butterfly placement, greenhouse environment, and portrait framing consistently. The reference is replaceable with another approved adult subject or butterfly-garden variation while retaining the same visual hierarchy. Explicitly define replacement identity, outfit, product, logo, environment, or typography; do not invent them.
